exportDlg.excerptsOff: Citations show the file and line only
exportDlg.excerptsOn: A citation opens ±3 lines of its code
exportDlg.langHint: The document text stays as written (no translation)
exportDlg.lead: One file, no network, read-only. The floor plan, contents, citations and ⌘K work as here. 0 tokens
exportDlg.title: Export as HTML
settings.antigravityLogin: Sign in in the official Antigravity app or your own CLI. Set AI Credit Overages to Never in its official settings to stop automatic credit overages.
settings.argvHint: The first entry is a CLI on PATH or an absolute path. Supports {model}, {effort}, {promptFile}, {emptyCwd}. Use muse-bin instead of its auto-updating launcher. Do not enter secrets.
settings.codexEstimateHint: Uses official Codex subscription authentication. This is not a hard spending cap on reasoning. Uncheck above to use an external MCP session.
settings.codexGuidedHint: Configure the Codex model and execution settings using Codex in the AI selector above and its setup command.
settings.exportLead: The design doc as one HTML file: no network, read-only — the recipient just opens it in a browser
settings.externalSetup: Pass the design document and source references to the selected tool. Follow the instructions printed in your terminal.
settings.floorplanNote: Rooms reflect source LOC and doors reflect imports. Repositories that fail the readability gate use the dependency map
settings.keyEnv: Environment variable holding the API key
settings.keyEnvHint: Do not enter the key itself. Set the named environment variable in your terminal before starting mitori.
settings.loginFallback: Could not open a terminal. Run this command in your own terminal.
settings.loginOpened: Opened a terminal for authentication. Review the executable and finish official sign-in. The official tool keeps your credentials. Reload settings when finished.
settings.museContributor: Contributor prompts and completions are eligible for Meta model training. Saving does not consent to sending data.
settings.museSubscription: Saved API keys take priority over browser sign-in. After terminal confirmation, this action clears the official Muse sign-in and reconnects through the browser. Review plan allowance and overages in the official tool.
settings.museUpdated: Muse updated itself and the configured binary is gone. Run this in a terminal to confirm the new version, then save.
settings.ollamaLogin: Local models need no login. This button is for Ollama cloud, which consumes your plan allowance or credits.
settings.pricingHint: USD per million tokens. Check provider prices; local models with no token charges can use zero.
settings.providerInvalid: Could not save. Check the model id, executable and JSON argument array, token prices and connection.
settings.providerSaved: Saved. Check the recipient and data policy on the generation card before sending.
settings.providerSetup: Register the executable with confirmation in your terminal. Run this command, then save again.
settings.quickSetupCwd: The launcher is unavailable; run this from a terminal in your mitori clone.
settings.quickSetupLead: Connect the AI you already use. Reuse an installed tool or a running local LLM.
settings.quickSetupSteps: Copy and run this command in a terminal. Review and confirm the setup, then select Reload settings.
settings.setupInvalid: Check the model, API URL, environment variable name, prices and repository path.
settings.singleKeysNote: When off, use buttons, ⌘K and modifier shortcuts only (WCAG 2.1.4)
settings.subscriptionLogin: Sign in to the official tool with your own account. Its supported plan allowance and billing settings apply. Do not enter API keys or credentials in mitori. Review overage settings in the official tool.
settings.title: Settings
settings.useApi: Connect with an API key (check its pricing and allowance)
